amendments.when: pre-data (before any claim measurement; the pre-amendment before-run is not kept as a claim receipt)
amendments.change: m1 (header trio) scoped to entries whose FIRST-ADD commit descends from the fleet round-1 baseline 284ab0f0 (where criterion 10 landed), and the 'header block' redefined as 'all text before the first `##` section' instead of 'before the first H1'.
amendments.why: The first run counted 66 m1 mismatches: it flagged 22 pre-criterion historical notes the criterion explicitly does not cover, and it mis-read the trio of entries that place it after the H1 (this lane uses both layouts). Result: total 74 -> 15, every remaining class a real record defect.

amendments.change: the behavior oracle's leg-name extraction reads the run_regression head section, not the tally block; the block extractor returns (head, block).
amendments.why: The first control run refused every copy with SETUP: no leg assignments found — the block starts at `local nlegs=`, so its own prefix is empty. Fixed before the control receipt committed here.

amendments.change: the multi-line record separator changed from U+001E to U+001F and result parsing moved from str.splitlines() to split('\n').
amendments.why: Python's splitlines() splits at U+001E, so every full-stdout record lost its second line and the oracle comparison was vacuous. Caught by the counter's own first self-run against the pristine runner (30316/30316 mismatched).

amendments.when: pre-data (no default-mode C1 run, no sealed set; before and control receipts re-run after it)
amendments.change: The four (auto,KEEP) triples were driven with fixed root literals; the runner's real auto root is root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/tameshi-r4-2-regression.XXXXXX) (tools/mutate-and-run.sh:1357-1365). Both the tool and the counter now drive the auto triples with a real /tmp directory carrying that exact prefix. The public panel gains two root-keyed kill copies (root-keyed-auto-mask, root-keyed-auto-zero) and the counter reads panel copies from committed bytes at REV.
amendments.why: Round-35 wave-1 seat RevengerRootShape found CRITICAL: a copy gating nfail=0 on the real auto root was ACCEPTED by v3 (and would have been scored accept by the counter's ground truth) while masking a failing leg into PASS under the runner's default --regression run. The witness-shim class is real and the claim would otherwise be false beyond its simulated literals.
amendments.selftest: TALLY_AUDIT_V3_SELFTEST: 30/30 pass (28 + real-root kill seed + real-root comment accept seed)

amendments.change: Sealed provenance hardened against round-35 wave-1 seat ReviewSealedGate: manifest.json is never parsed as a specimen (HYGIENE-1); the freeze is the commit that FIRST ADDED contract.json, read from history, and the manifest must name it (BOUND-1); last-touch must be a strict descendant of the freeze (BOUND-3) and the lineage creation commit must also descend from it (BOUND-2 move/copy); provenance and scoring both read bytes committed at REV (BOUND-4 dirty worktree, HYGIENE-3 HEAD-vs-rev); the --sealed path is used for provenance instead of a hardcoded literal (HYGIENE-2). A plain copy-in of pre-freeze content (not a git rename) remains a fail-open limit, recorded in the lesson.
amendments.why: the gate as frozen proved touch, not authorship, and scored uncommitted bytes.
